title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções para o setor de telecomunicações.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente da sustentação das integrações existentes e evolução de novos produtos.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-vendas e apresentações técnicas para clientes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (preferência para Java 11+).
  • Proficiência com Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Web, Security, Data).
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Familiaridade com API Gateways como Kong ou Apigee.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger ou ELK).


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas técnicas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos e atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para clientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas técnicos.
  • Visão sistêmica sobre o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end (React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Conhecimento de segurança de APIs e práticas de CQRs.
  • Experiência com PL/SQL e tuning de queries.


Você vai amar trabalhar aqui se:

  • Quiser ter a possibilidade de aprender e trabalhar com diversas tecnologias;
  • Estiver em busca de uma empresa com possibilidades reais de crescimento e carreira;
  • Estiver em busca de um ambiente leve e descontraído para trabalhar;


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;

  • Plano de saúde;

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);


E mais: Trabalho Híbrido.

  • Apoio a certificações;

title: SQL Architect - Brazil (Remote)
description:
Job Title: SQL Architect

Role Type: Solution Architect / Technical Architect


Experience Requirements

  • 15+ years of overall IT experience
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience with public cloud platforms, primarily Microsoft Azure , including:
  • Azure Migrate
  • Azure SQL (IaaS / PaaS)
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure IAM

Primary Skills & Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate strong proficiency and hands-on expertise in delivering high-quality architecture designs using standard architecture frameworks
  • Conduct AS-IS application assessments , design target-state architectures , and obtain approvals from client Architecture Review Boards
  • Perform on-premises and public cloud infrastructure assessments using Azure Migrate
  • Drive Azure cloud solutioning for large-scale, complex migration programs
  • Ensure proposed solutions align with:
  • Azure strategy
  • Stakeholder management
  • Business, Application, and Infrastructure architecture
  • Commercial value considerations (value for money; excluding cost modeling)
  • Work across multiple industry domains, including:
  • Banking
  • Healthcare
  • Insurance
  • Analyze and understand customer infrastructure landscapes
  • Design and implement Azure Landing Zone architectures
  • Provide Azure target architectures , including:
  • Bill of Materials (BoM)
  • Pricing and licensing details
  • Create Azure solution architecture diagrams , covering:
  • All Azure services
  • High-Level Design (HLD)
  • Low-Level Design (LLD)
  • Troubleshoot Azure and Windows environments, including:
  • Processor
  • Networking
  • Clusters
  • I/O
  • Memory-related issues

Secondary Skills

  • Design infrastructure and data storage solutions
  • Design business continuity and disaster recovery (DR) solutions
  • Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
  • Collaborate with internal teams, customer stakeholders, and project managers to understand migration requirements and deliver appropriate solutions

Certifications (Good to Have)

  • AZ-305: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions
  • AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator

title: Software Architect
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!


About the client

  • A global energy technology organization focused on supporting the world’s growing energy needs while accelerating the transition to more sustainable and reliable energy systems.
  • Operates across the full energy value chain, from conventional power to renewables, grid technology, and energy storage.
  • Known for large-scale, mission-critical platforms that support energy infrastructure worldwide and emphasize reliability, security, and long-term impact.


About the role

  • This is a senior-level role within a long-standing, business-critical remote monitoring software platform.
  • The position combines responsibility for maintaining a complex legacy system with leading a major modernization initiative.
  • The engineer will act as a technical bridge between current architectures and a future cloud-native, domain-driven platform.
  • The role requires strong backend, frontend, cloud, and infrastructure expertise in highly regulated, high-availability environments.


Responsibilities

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize a 10-year-old .NET and SQL Server codebase to ensure 99.9% uptime for remote monitoring services.
  • Lead the refactoring and gradual replacement of monolithic modules into modern microservices using .NET 6+, MongoDB, and Domain Driven Design (DDD).
  • Develop and migrate user interfaces to a modern, responsive Angular framework.
  • Own and manage the operational environment across legacy Windows Servers and modern Linux (Debian/RedHat) systems.
  • Drive adoption of AWS cloud services and containerization using Kubernetes.
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure Pipelines.
  • Implement and maintain automated testing using NUnit and SpecFlow.
  • Ensure all software meets strict security, quality, and compliance requirements for critical energy infrastructure.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in .NET (6+), including ASP.NET and ADO.NET.
  • Extensive experience with Microsoft SQL Server (2016+).
  • Commercial experience with Angular for complex Single Page Applications.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (compute, storage, and networking services).
  • Experience deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency with CI/CD practices and Azure Pipelines.
  • Test automation experience using NUnit and SpecFlow.
  • Strong understanding and practical application of Domain Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experience administering Windows Server and Linux (Debian or Red Hat).
  • Solid understanding of secure coding practices and compliance standards.
  • Ability to work effectively in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).


Nice to have skills

  • German language skills.
  • Prior experience in modernizing large, mission-critical legacy systems.
  • Exposure to highly regulated or industrial software environments.


Conditions

  • 100% remote role, primarily aligned to the UTC+0 time zone.
  • Contractor role, 12-month contract, renewable.
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).

Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Everyone has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits discriminatory practices.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression
  • A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work
  • Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence


Smurfit Westrock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to create and maintain a diverse workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Smurfit Westrock does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression
  • A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work
  • Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Sobre nós:

A Unlimitail é uma joint venture entre o Grupo Carrefour e o Grupo Publicis, que tem como objetivo atender ao crescente mercado de retail media na Europa e América Latina, desenvolvendo soluções eficazes para as principais necessidades do mercado: vender mais, personalização, oportunidades para as marcas, medição e transparência e presença omnicanal.

A empresa se destaca no mercado hoje graças à sua experiência e tecnologia de publicidade de ponta, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, que unifica recursos onsite e offsite. Além disso, a Unlimitail oferece alcance global e dados de alta qualidade, com mais de 1,5 bilhão de visualizações de página mensais e um banco de dados de mais de 120 milhões de clientes endereçáveis em todo o mundo.



Contexto da Vaga de Emprego:

Você fará parte do Data Pipelines Squad, responsável por ingerir, preparar e normalizar fontes de dados que alimentam produtos de analytics, IA e retail media. O time atua com Arquitetura Medallion (Bronze > Silver), e a plataforma central de dados é construída sobre a Google Cloud, com forte foco em BigQuery e dbt para transformações e datasets governados.



Missão:

Como Senior Data Engineer, você será responsável por construir e operar pipelines confiáveis que movem dados de fontes brutas para camadas curadas e reutilizáveis. Garantirá a qualidade, consistência e performance dos conjuntos de dados utilizados pelos times de analytics e data science. Você será uma referência técnica sênior dentro do squad, influenciando arquitetura e padrões, além de trabalhar de forma próxima com stakeholders globais, utilizando inglês no dia a dia.



Principais Atividades:

Ingestão e Preparação de Dados

  • Consumir dados de múltiplas fontes (APIs, arquivos, bancos de dados, parceiros e sistemas internos);
  • Implementar padrões de ingestão na camada Bronze (dados brutos, auditáveis e reproduzíveis).

Transformações Medallion com dbt

  • Desenvolver e manter projetos em dbt para construção de datasets curados;
  • Desenhar e implementar transformações de Bronze para Silver (dados limpos, normalizados e conformados);
  • Definir modelos reutilizáveis, macros e documentação alinhados ao consumo analítico.

Engenharia e Otimização em BigQuery

  • Construir e otimizar datasets no BigQuery;
  • Melhorar performance, particionamento, clusterização e eficiência de custos;
  • Garantir design escalável para grandes volumes de dados e ciclos frequentes de atualização.

Qualidade e Governança de Dados

  • Implementar checagens de qualidade de dados (atualização, completude, variação de schema, anomalias);
  • Garantir rastreabilidade, versionamento e clareza de ownership dos principais datasets;
  • Manter documentação e padrões para ativos de dados compartilhados.

Colaboração e Enablement

  • Atuar em parceria com times de Analytics/BI (consumidores de Looker e Looker Studio) e Data Science;
  • Alinhar com stakeholders de Produto e Negócio, traduzindo necessidades em contratos de dados;
  • Trabalhar diariamente com um squad global (Brasil + França), em inglês.



Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Forte experiência como Senior Data Engineer;
  • SQL avançado;
  • Experiência prática sólida com dbt (requisito central);
  • Forte experiência com BigQuery (modelagem, otimização e controle de custos);
  • Experiência no desenho de pipelines ELT confiáveis e camadas de dados curadas;
  • Boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, code review, documentação);
  • Excelente comunicação e gestão de stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).



Habilidades Desejadas:

  • Experiência com Terraform ou Infrastructure as Code (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce, marketplace ou retail media;
  • CI/CD para workflows de dados;
  • Vivência com padrões orientados a eventos ou near real-time;
  • Francês será um diferencial.



Perfil Preferencial:

  • Contribuidor individual sênior;
  • Data engineer com mentalidade de plataforma;
  • Forte experiência prática com dbt e BigQuery;
  • Confortável em construir e manter camadas Bronze e Silver em uma Arquitetura Medallion;
  • Foco em confiabilidade, qualidade e escalabilidade dos dados;
  • Confortável em atuar nos bastidores, habilitando squads de analytics e IA;
  • Forte senso de ownership sobre os principais ativos de dados;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes globais e complexos;
  • Comunicação clara, colaborando com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Influencia arquitetura e padrões por excelência técnica, não por hierarquia.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Sobre nós:

A Unlimitail é uma joint venture entre o Grupo Carrefour e o Grupo Publicis, que tem como objetivo atender ao crescente mercado de retail media na Europa e América Latina, desenvolvendo soluções eficazes para as principais necessidades do mercado: vender mais, personalização, oportunidades para as marcas, medição e transparência e presença omnicanal.

A empresa se destaca no mercado hoje graças à sua experiência e tecnologia de publicidade de ponta, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, que unifica recursos onsite e offsite. Além disso, a Unlimitail oferece alcance global e dados de alta qualidade, com mais de 1,5 bilhão de visualizações de página mensais e um banco de dados de mais de 120 milhões de clientes endereçáveis em todo o mundo.



Contexto da Vaga de Emprego:

Você fará parte do Data Pipelines Squad, responsável por ingerir, preparar e normalizar fontes de dados que alimentam produtos de analytics, IA e retail media. O time atua com Arquitetura Medallion (Bronze > Silver), e a plataforma central de dados é construída sobre a Google Cloud, com forte foco em BigQuery e dbt para transformações e datasets governados.



Missão:

Como Senior Data Engineer, você será responsável por construir e operar pipelines confiáveis que movem dados de fontes brutas para camadas curadas e reutilizáveis. Garantirá a qualidade, consistência e performance dos conjuntos de dados utilizados pelos times de analytics e data science. Você será uma referência técnica sênior dentro do squad, influenciando arquitetura e padrões, além de trabalhar de forma próxima com stakeholders globais, utilizando inglês no dia a dia.



Principais Atividades:

Ingestão e Preparação de Dados

  • Consumir dados de múltiplas fontes (APIs, arquivos, bancos de dados, parceiros e sistemas internos);
  • Implementar padrões de ingestão na camada Bronze (dados brutos, auditáveis e reproduzíveis).

Transformações Medallion com dbt

  • Desenvolver e manter projetos em dbt para construção de datasets curados;
  • Desenhar e implementar transformações de Bronze para Silver (dados limpos, normalizados e conformados);
  • Definir modelos reutilizáveis, macros e documentação alinhados ao consumo analítico.

Engenharia e Otimização em BigQuery

  • Construir e otimizar datasets no BigQuery;
  • Melhorar performance, particionamento, clusterização e eficiência de custos;
  • Garantir design escalável para grandes volumes de dados e ciclos frequentes de atualização.

Qualidade e Governança de Dados

  • Implementar checagens de qualidade de dados (atualização, completude, variação de schema, anomalias);
  • Garantir rastreabilidade, versionamento e clareza de ownership dos principais datasets;
  • Manter documentação e padrões para ativos de dados compartilhados.

Colaboração e Enablement

  • Atuar em parceria com times de Analytics/BI (consumidores de Looker e Looker Studio) e Data Science;
  • Alinhar com stakeholders de Produto e Negócio, traduzindo necessidades em contratos de dados;
  • Trabalhar diariamente com um squad global (Brasil + França), em inglês.



Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Forte experiência como Senior Data Engineer;
  • SQL avançado;
  • Experiência prática sólida com dbt (requisito central);
  • Forte experiência com BigQuery (modelagem, otimização e controle de custos);
  • Experiência no desenho de pipelines ELT confiáveis e camadas de dados curadas;
  • Boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, code review, documentação);
  • Excelente comunicação e gestão de stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).



Habilidades Desejadas:

  • Experiência com Terraform ou Infrastructure as Code (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce, marketplace ou retail media;
  • CI/CD para workflows de dados;
  • Vivência com padrões orientados a eventos ou near real-time;
  • Francês será um diferencial.

title: Azure / Windows Architect - Remote (Brazil)
description:
Azure / Windows Architect


Experience

  • 13+ years of overall IT experience
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in:
  • Azure Infrastructure
  • Azure Migrate
  • Azure Networking (Azure IaaS / PaaS)
  • Data Center, Cloud, Security, SIAM
  • Data & Storage areas (Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM)
  • Experience managing and technically guiding teams of 5+ Infra resources
  • Willing to provide 24x7 support and flexible to work in shifts

Primary Skills

  • Expertise in on-prem and public cloud infrastructure assessments using Azure Migrate
  • Driving cloud solutioning and Azure activities for large, complex migrations
  • Ensure proposed solutions cover:
  • Azure strategy
  • Stakeholder management
  • Business, Application, and Infrastructure aspects
  • Commercial aspects (value for money, not commercial costing)
  • Experience working across industry domains such as:
  • Banking
  • Healthcare
  • Insurance
  • Understanding customer infrastructure landscape
  • Design and build Azure Landing Zone activities
  • Clear understanding of TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI (Return on Investment)

  • Migrate on-prem workloads to Azure using Azure Migrate
  • Troubleshooting experience in Azure & Windows environments:
  • Processor
  • Networking
  • Clusters
  • IO
  • Memory
  • Define and realize end-to-end solution architecture addressing:
  • Business processes
  • Domain regulations
  • Quality attributes
  • Economy of solution

  • Troubleshooting skills with cluster-related issues
  • Hands-on experience in:
  • Server consolidations
  • Windows Clustering
  • Strong administration knowledge of:

  • WINS
  • DHCP Servers
  • Experience in upgrading and migrating Windows Servers to later versions
  • Strong knowledge of server backup and restoration
  • Hands-on experience restoring OS and data files from backup

  • Provide inputs for continuous improvement

  • Strong customer engagement skills
  • Ability to prepare and deliver solution presentations
  • Positive attitude
  • Excellent communication skills for customer calls
  • Strong teamwork abilities
  • Excellent problem-solving skills

title: Strategic Distribution Partner – Brazil (Cardiology / Heart Failure)
description:
Acorai is preparing to expand into the Brazilian market and is seeking a best-in-class strategic distribution partner in Brazil to lead commercialization of its next-generation, non-invasive hemodynamic monitoring solution for heart failure care pathways.

What we’re looking for

We’re interested in partnering with an established Brazilian medical device distributor/importer that can:

  • Drive adoption in cardiology/heart failure across key hospital networks
  • Provide clinical education & field support (KOL development, onboarding, workflow integration)
  • Handle service/logistics and post-market processes at hospital-grade standards
  • Navigate local commercialization realities (procurement, tenders where relevant, hospital committees)
What a partnership could look like
  • Territory: Brazil (exclusive potential)
  • Structure: Performance-based exclusivity with clear milestones
  • Launch approach: Pilot-site activation + clinical education + structured scale-up plan
  • Alignment: Long-term partnership orientation with shared execution focus
Who should reach out
  • Distributor principals / CEOs / GMs
  • Leaders of cardiology-focused distributor groups
  • Regional medtech operators with a strong hospital network and commercialization engine
Next steps

If this matches your organization, message us with:

  • Your company overview + therapeutic focus
  • Coverage footprint (cities/states) and sales/service organization
  • 2–3 examples of similar hospital-launched products you’ve scaled
  • Your view on a 6–12 month launch plan in Brazil

title: Web Designer
description:
Required Skills & Experience

*Experience writing and manipulating HTML

* Proficient in English, attentive to industry standards, and equipped with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Proficient with Figma for prototyping, sharing/testing designs

* Experience with utilizing a Design System

* Experience with front-end testing

*Experience working within a CMS to build webpages with components


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

*Experience in Adobe Creative suite (Photoshop)

* Experience contributing to a Design System

* Experience working with Adobe Experience Manager


Job Description

A BioTech client is seeking a Web Designer to join their team remotely in Brazil. This person will:

* Facilitate front-end content and code updates to the marketing website within Adobe Experience Manager

* Utilize brand guidelines and design system insights to build out new pages and experiences using existing code

* Collaborate closely with UX team to prototype intuitive experiences

* Source and manipulate imagery to create web-formatted graphics & banners

* Design layouts and templates for global solutions that focus on user experience

* Present design solutions to stakeholders and leadership

* Contribute to collaborative design sessions

* Support cross-browser testing at multiple stages of a project

* Evolve and build out the marketing site component and pattern libraries

** This role can pay up to $3,400 USD monthly

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.


  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.


  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).


  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs.


  • Perform data migration and ensure data integrity.


  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.


  • Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning.


  • Stay updated with Salesforce releases and best practices.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Apex, Visualforce, LWC, SOQL, SOSL.


  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration and customization.


  • Knowledge of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, and governor limits.


  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (API, middleware tools like MuleSoft).


  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools (Change Sets, ANT, SFDX).


  • Good understanding of Agile methodology.

title: Operations Associate
description:
Operations Associate | Remote (Brazil) | U.S. Market


At Blue Dot BPO , we support U.S.-based companies in building efficient, scalable, and results-driven operations. We are looking for an Operations Associate who is analytical, highly organized, and has a strong sense of ownership to support and optimize critical operational processes in a dynamic, fully remote environment, working directly with the U.S. market.


This is a strategic position for professionals who want to grow in operations, project management, and business analysis while working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$4,000
  • Full-time Brazil contract
  • 100% remote , working directly with the U.S. market
  • Work schedule: 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term contract with growth opportunities
  • International, multicultural, and performance-driven environment


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the analysis and optimization of operational processes across departments
  • Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements (SOPs and best practices)
  • Support and/or manage cross-department projects, ensuring deadlines and deliverables
  • Act as a point of contact between operations, leadership, and stakeholders
  • Create operational reports, data analysis, and performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Support strategic decision-making with data and actionable insights
  • Ensure proper organization of documentation, processes, and internal communication


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or related fields
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S.-based teams and stakeholders)
  • Previous experience in operations, business analysis, or project coordination

title: Arquiteto Sr. - Qualidade de Projetos
description:
A Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) é uma empresa de engenharia MEP (Mecânica, Elétrica e Hidráulica) com sede em Nova York e em rápido crescimento. Já realizamos mais de 300 projetos e projetamos mais de 3 milhões de pés quadrados de área construída em NY, atuando com arquitetos, engenheiros, marcas nacionais e internacionais.


Estamos contratando um(a) arquiteto(a) remoto, baseado(a) no Brasil, para assumir e escalar nosso processo de QA/QC (Garantia e Controle de Qualidade) em projetos de engenharia, garantindo que todos os projetos atendam consistentemente aos nossos padrões à medida que crescemos.


Importante

Esta não é uma posição focada em revisar entregáveis linha por linha. O objetivo do cargo é garantir que o processo de projeto seja executado corretamente e que todas as etapas de controle de qualidade sejam cumpridas em 100% dos projetos, reduzindo erros de projeto, falhas de comunicação e retrabalho.


Remuneração & Estrutura

  • Tempo integral (remoto)
  • Remuneração R$8.000,00 + bônus


Responsabilidades

  • Assumir o processo de QA/QC de ponta a ponta em projetos MEP: definir, implementar e melhorar continuamente checklists, stage gates (marcos de controle) e critérios de “definition of done”.
  • Garantir conformidade: assegurar que todas as verificações de qualidade exigidas sejam concluídas (com rastreabilidade) em todos os projetos, sem exceções.
  • Padronizar fluxos de trabalho: templates, organização de arquivos, convenções de nomenclatura, rotinas de coordenação, requisitos de handoff e documentação interna.
  • Melhorar comunicação e transições: reduzir perda de informação entre equipes, disciplinas e stakeholders.
  • Acompanhar métricas de qualidade: criar dashboards e relatórios semanais sobre não conformidades, causas de retrabalho, tempo de ciclo, erros recorrentes e aderência aos processos.
  • Análise de causa raiz e prevenção: investigar falhas, implementar ações corretivas e garantir que as melhorias sejam sustentáveis.


Requisitos

  • Formação em Arquitetura.
  • Inglês avançado (escrito e falado) para trabalhar com equipe e clientes nos EUA.
  • Experiência em ambientes Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção (projeto Sistemas Prediais, engenharia, coordenação BIM, entrega de projetos, design ops, PMO, QA/QC).
  • Mentalidade forte de dono de processo: disciplina, organização e acompanhamento consistente.
  • Capacidade de garantir conformidade entre equipes, sem ser o “revisor de tudo”.
  • Conforto em criar SOPs, checklists e rotinas de governança que escalam com o crescimento da empresa.


Nice to Have

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, ACC/BIM 360, Asana, Monday, Jira , entre outras.
  • Histórico comprovado de melhoria de qualidade e redução de retrabalho por meio de sistemas e processos melhores.


Selection Process

  • Aplicação: candidatura à vaga, com envio de CV, experiência em inglês e histórico com CRM.
  • Triagem: avaliação de inglês e comunicação.
  • Case técnico: desafio técnico curto.
  • Entrevistas: com a liderança e o CEO.
  • Oferta


Why join Downtown?

  • Papel estratégico em uma empresa de NYC em rápido crescimento.
  • Clientes altamente satisfeitos.
  • Time de engenharia forte em todas as disciplinas.
  • Mentalidade de startup voltada para crescimento e construção de equipe.
  • Só contratamos pessoas que se destacam.

title: Strategic Operations Project Coordinator
description:
Strategic Operations Project Coordinator


We are currently hiring for a division which focuses on providing services to immigration law firms across the United States.


The Strategic Operations Project Coordinator will serve as a key support resource to operational leadership, combining elements of project coordination, business analysis, and administrative management. This role is responsible for managing small-to-medium projects, conducting research and analysis, building documentation, performing system testing, and offloading administrative tasks from senior leaders to improve organizational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in AI tools and demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities

-Project Management

  • Manage and coordinate small-to-medium projects from initiation through completion.
  • Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are met on schedule.
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and communicate project status to leadership.
  • Identify and escalate project risks or blockers appropriately.


-Operational Support

  • Offload administrative and analytical tasks from operational leaders including report generation, data compilation, and meeting preparation.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive intelligence, process improvements, and business opportunities.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic documents.
  • Support special initiatives and ad-hoc requests from leadership.


-Analysis and Reporting

  • Perform light data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards for leadership review.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend efficiency improvements.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries.


-Documentation and System Testing

  • Build and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
  • Conduct system testing for new features, integrations, or process changes.
  • Document test results, identify issues, and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, current, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.


-AI Tool Utilization

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, etc.) to enhance productivity and output quality.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI capabilities to operational challenges.
  • Stay current on AI tool developments and best practices.


Qualification

-Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination, business analysis, or administrative support roles
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) in professional contexts
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to take initiative


-Preferred:

  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power Automate, or other Microsoft 365 automation tools
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or similar credentials

  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights

  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to take initiative


-Preferred:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Required Skills & Qualifications:


  • English: Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience: 5+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering role.
  • Containerization & Orchestration: Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes , Docker , and Helm .
  • Cloud Platforms: Proficiency with either GCP or AWS services.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: Deep experience with CI/CD platforms like GitLab/GitHub Actions and Jenkins .
  • Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience with Terraform .
  • Observability & Monitoring: Proven experience with the Prometheus/Grafana/Loki stack for monitoring, logging, and alerting.
  • Scripting & Automation: Strong programming skills in Python or GoLang , as well as shell scripting.
  • DevSecOps: Familiarity with embedding security in the CI/CD pipeline and secret management with HashiCorp Vault .
  • Full Stack: A solid understanding of full-stack development principles to effectively support development teams.


Bonus Qualifications:


  • Experience with Service Meshes like Istio or Linkerd.
  • Experience with GitOps tools like ArgoCD or Flux .
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS/GCP Certified.
  • Experience with advanced cloud-native services like Cloudflare, Cloud Run, or AWS Lambda.
  • Familiarity with other observability tools like Jaeger or OpenTelemetry.

title: Finance & Operations Analyst (Part-time)
description:
Responsabilidades
Financeiro
  • Executar pagamentos internacionais via Deel, Mercury, Stripe, Appmax e Wise .
  • Garantir que todos os colaboradores e fornecedores recebam corretamente dentro do prazo.
  • Processar refunds de clientes  (Stripe/Appmax) e registrar motivos.
  • Atualizar planilha/Airtable de fluxo de caixa  e gerar snapshot semanal para o fundador.


Contratos & Legal Ops
  • Criar e gerenciar contratos de freelancers e fornecedores via Deel  (criação, renovação e encerramento).
  • Organizar e arquivar documentos em Notion/Drive.
  • Acompanhar prazos de vencimento e renovações.


Billing & SaaS
  • Controlar assinaturas de ferramentas SaaS da empresa (Zoom, Notion, Slack, etc.).
  • Garantir billing correto e evitar cobranças duplicadas/desnecessárias.
  • Monitorar entradas de clientes (Stripe/Appmax) e sinalizar inconsistências.


Relatórios & Compliance
  • Atualizar semanalmente indicadores financeiros básicos (entradas, saídas, refunds).
  • Apoiar no cálculo de CAC, LTV, ROAS, margem  junto ao time de Marketing.
  • Garantir que todos os pagamentos passem pelos gateways oficiais , sem exceções manuais.


Suporte Executivo
  • Preparar snapshot financeiro semanal para o Founder.
  • Agendar calls financeiras com contadores, gateways e bancos.
  • Manter documentos fiscais e contratuais organizados para futura due diligence.


Requisitos
  • Inglês funcional (intermediário, suficiente para lidar com plataformas e suporte).
  • Experiência prévia com pagamentos cross-border  (freelancers, SaaS ou startups).
  • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas como Deel, Stripe, Mercury, Appmax, Wise .
  • Perfil altamente organizado, atencioso a detalhes e comprometido com prazos. (obrigatório)
  • Disponibilidade part-time (~14–20h semanais) .

title: Consultor
description:
- Prospecção de clientes: identificar e abordar potenciais compradores, por meio de visitas, indicações, contatos telefônicos, redes sociais e outros canais de captação.

- Apresentação de produtos: explicar de forma clara e objetiva o funcionamento do consórcio, vantagens, modalidades, prazos e condições.

- Atendimento consultivo: entender o perfil e necessidade de cada cliente, oferecendo soluções personalizadas para aquisição de bens e serviços via consórcio.

- Negociação e fechamento de vendas: conduzir o processo comercial, esclarecer dúvidas e apresentar propostas que atendam às expectativas do cliente.

- Acompanhamento de clientes: manter relacionamento pós-venda, oferecendo suporte e orientação ao longo da jornada no consórcio.

- Gestão de carteira: administrar a carteira de clientes ativos e potenciais, garantindo fidelização e novas indicações.

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally.   • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English

Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.

title: Engenheiro De Controle
description:
About Woodgrove


We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.


Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.


All resumes must be in english.


Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.G., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.


Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Development of BI solutions (50%):

Consult (30%):

  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.G., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role;
experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.G., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Coordenador Fiscal - Torre De Faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:


Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.


Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.


Qualificações & requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte deliderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;


Competências comportamentais:


  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidadeanalítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação pararesultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;


Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

title: Especialista De Contratos
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista de Contratos para atuar de forma estratégica e colaborativa, contribuindo diretamente para a segurança, eficiência e excelência na gestão contratual da empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações

· Ensino Superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas.

· Experiência na área de Contratos ou função similar.

· Inglês Avançado (oral e escrita).


Responsabilidades e atribuições

· Realizar análise prévia e detalhada de contratos, identificando critérios críticos para docagens, mobilizações, construções, aditivos e demais atividades contratuais.

· Apoiar áreas técnicas e gerenciais na interpretação de cláusulas e no entendimento de obrigações operacionais e comerciais associadas às embarcações.

· Identificar riscos contratuais e apoiar a elaboração de estratégias de mitigação, incluindo recomendações técnicas e comerciais.

· Controlar e acompanhar aditivos, termos e alterações contratuais, garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade documental e alinhamento com o escopo.

· Elaborar estudos financeiros sobre multas, taxas, reajustes e variações contratuais, subsidiando tomadas de decisão.

· Monitorar KPIs e indicadores de desempenho contratual, transformando dados em insights estratégicos.

· Registrar e consolidar lições aprendidas, promovendo a melhoria contínua.

· Organizar, atualizar e acompanhar informações críticas dos contratos, garantindo visibilidade para todas as áreas envolvidas.

· Assegurar comprovação documental de cumprimento de obrigações: vistorias, diários, fotos, atas, inventários, notas fiscais, certificados, entre outros.

· Gerir o banco de dados contratual e documentos associados aos processos de docagens, mobilizações, construções e aditivos.

· Mapear, registrar e monitorar iniciativas relacionadas à Lei do Bem, garantindo conformidade, documentação adequada e aproveitamento dos incentivos fiscais.

· Atuar de forma integrada às demais áreas envolvidas nos processos de docagens, mobilizações, construções e aditivos, contribuindo para governança, estruturação e acompanhamento das atividades sob sua responsabilidade.


Requisitos desejáveis

Domínio em pacote Office, conhecimento básico sobre embarcações de apoio marítimo, conhecimento em contratos Petrobras e conhecimento em contratos internacionais do tipo BIMCO.


Benefícios

  • Trabalho híbrido (4x presencial e 1x remoto);


  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, extensivo aos dependentes;


  • Vale Alimentação/ Refeição;


  • Vale Transporte;


  • Previdência Privada;


  • Plataforma de cursos online para todos os colaboradores;


  • Plataforma para apoiar no cuidado a saúde mental;


  • Benefício de Academias e Plataforma de Incentivo a rotina saudável.

title: Inspetor De Qualidade
description:
1. Missão do Cargo


Garantir que produtos, processos e materiais atendam aos requisitos especificados pela empresa, clientes e normas aplicáveis, por meio de inspeções, registros e monitoramentos sistemáticos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade.


⸻


2. Principais Responsabilidades

- Realizar inspeções de recebimento, processo e produto final, conforme procedimentos e planos de inspeção.

- Registrar e manter atualizados os resultados das inspeções nos formulários, sistemas ou relatórios definidos.

- Identificar, segregar e registrar materiais ou produtos não conformes, comunicando aos responsáveis.

- Apoiar na investigação de não conformidades, realizar análises preliminares e sugerir ações corretivas/ver preventivas.

- Utilizar instrumentos de medição (paquímetro, micrômetro, gabaritos, etc.) garantindo conformidade com padrões.

- Preencher relatórios de inspeção, laudos e demais documentos relacionados ao controle da qualidade.

- Acompanhar testes e ensaios, garantindo que sejam cumpridos os requisitos técnicos.

- Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores da qualidade.

- Cumprir e fazer cumprir os procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (ISO 9001 ou outros aplicáveis).

- Sugerir melhorias nos processos, produtos e métodos de inspeção.


⸻


3. Competências Técnicas

- Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos (quando aplicável).

- Uso de instrumentos de medição e inspeção.

- Conhecimento básico/intermediário da ISO 9001.

- Registro e controle de não conformidades.

- Noções de ferramentas da qualidade (5S, diagrama de causa e efeito, PDCA, etc.).


⸻


4. Competências Comportamentais

- Atenção aos detalhes.

- Organização e disciplina nos registros.

- Comunicação clara e objetiva.

- Proatividade e foco em melhoria contínua.

- Imparcialidade e postura ética.

- Trabalho em equipe.


⸻


5. Formação e Experiência

- Ensino médio completo (técnico em qualidade ou áreas afins é diferencial).

- Experiência prévia em inspeção ou controle de qualidade.

- Desejável conhecimento em metrologia.

- Treinamentos específicos conforme a área de atuação (ex.: inspeção visual, instrumentos, processo produtivo).


⸻


6. Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)

- Taxa de retrabalho.

- Acuracidade de inspeção.

- Registros realizados dentro do prazo.

- Redução de não conformidades internas e externas.

- Cumprimento dos procedimentos de qualidade.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • Atleast 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

description:
Descrição da vaga


Você tem sangue nos olhos por novos negócios? É movido pela adrenalina de fechar o primeiro contrato e acredita que negócio bom se fecha no aperto de mão ?


Estamos buscando um(a) Executivo de Contas Hunter para atuar em modelo Presencial e Externo em Goiânia .

Responsabilidades e atribuições


Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Visitas e Prospecção: Realizar visitas presenciais constantes a prospects para diagnóstico e apresentação de soluções, garantindo uma agenda ativa e externa.

  • Networking: Participar de eventos e promover iniciativas que gerem leads qualificados para a sua carteira.


Requisitos e qualificações


O que é indispensável para a posição:

  • Mobilidade (Obrigatório): Possuir Veículo Próprio e CNH B ativa. A vaga exige deslocamento constante para visitas.
  • Experiência Hunter: Vivência mínima de 02 anos em vendas externas, com forte atuação em prospecção e visitas a clientes.
  • Formação: Graduação completa (Administração, TI, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins).
